en: Black‑and‑white landscape view of a hilltop with a tall cylindrical stone tower capped by a lantern-like lookout and pointed roof. The tower stands beside a small building partly hidden by dense trees. Winding footpaths and a narrow road climb the hillside, with a few telegraph poles and scattered houses lower down. In the distance are rolling hills or low mountains; the overall scene suggests a Central European hill town and an old watchtower or lookout tower.
